leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a component state to manage optimistic UI data
Implement a service method that simulates an API call with delayed response
Configure event handlers to update UI optimistically before API confirmation
Apply error handling to revert optimistic updates when API calls fail
Bind optimistic state changes to template elements for immediate feedback
Integrate loading indicators that show only during actual API operations
Manipulate component state to maintain data consistency between optimistic and confirmed states
